text:
Predicates:
Popular(x) ::: x is a popular Netflix show.
Netflix(x) ::: x is a Netflix show.
BingeWatch(x, y) ::: x will binge-watch y.
Download(x, y) ::: x will download y.
Share(x, y, z) ::: x will share y with z.
Premises:
Netflix(strangerThings) ∧ Popular(strangerThings) ::: "Stranger Things" is a popular Netflix show.
∀x (Netflix(x) ∧ Popular(x) → BingeWatch(karen, x)) ::: If a Netflix show is popular, Karen will binge-watch it.
∀x (Netflix(x) → (BingeWatch(karen, x) ↔ Download(karen, x))) ::: If and only if Karen binge-watches a Netflix show, she will download it.
¬Download(karen, blackMirror) ::: Karen does not download "Black Mirror".
Netflix(blackMirror) ::: "Black Mirror" is a Netflix show.
∀x (Netflix(x) ∧ BingeWatch(karen, x) → Share(karen, x, lisa)) ::: If Karen binge-watches a Netflix show, she will share it with Lisa.
Conclusion:
Share(karen, blackMirror, lisa) ::: Karen will share "Black Mirror" with Lisa.
